doc.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

title: Critics and reviews
summary: She reacts to a 'Jazz Times' review of Math Camp and favors praise from Frishberg and Bergman.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Are you mostly pleased with what jazz critics write about your work and you? I’m going to give you one that just — I spotted in a review in “Jazz Times.” “Intellectual jazz lab dedicated to the dissection of the human condition.”
Sounds like a “Math Camp” review. Yeah that’s fine. Yeah that’s okay. You know I mean nobody likes getting slammed but you know for the most part I’ve had some very
interesting things said about me. My favorites are by people who are not critics like Dave Frishberg and Alan Bergman. But yeah, I can see that. Sure.
